source.code:
/-- The canonical map from `List (α × Bool)` to the free group on `α`. -/
@[to_additive /-- The canonical map from `List (α × Bool)` to the free additive group on `α`. -/]
def mk (L : List (α × Bool)) : FreeGroup α :=
  Quot.mk Red.Step L
